title: Compute Omega from report counts — omega_from_counts
text: expected relative reporting rate additive-risk baseline model (eq. 16 Noren et al. 2008) $$g_{11} = 1 - \frac{1}{\max(o_{00}, o_{10}) + \max(o_{00}, o_{01}) - o_{00} + 1}$$ \(o_{ij} = f_{ij} / (1 - f_{ij})\) \(f_{ij}\) relative reporting rate event stratum exposed D1 () D2 (j). expected count \(E_{111} = g_{11} n_{11\cdot}\) $$\Omega = \log_2 \frac{n_{111} + \alpha_1}{E_{111} + \alpha_2}$$ Following paper, interval limits log2 quantiles posterior Gamma(shape = \(n_{111} + \alpha_1\), rate = \(E_{111} + \alpha_2\)) distribution (eq. 20). paper uses \(\alpha_1 = \alpha_2 = 0.5\), prior mean 1 shrinks Omega towards 0. \(\alpha_1 \neq \alpha_2\), prior mean \(\alpha_1 / \alpha_2\) Omega shrunk towards \(\log_2(\alpha_1 / \alpha_2)\) instead 0, changes meaning omega_lower > 0 signal criterion. Omega can computed four D1/D2 strata contain reports (\(n_{11\cdot}\), \(n_{10\cdot}\), \(n_{01\cdot}\), \(n_{00\cdot}\) > 0), reporting rates defined, \(f_{00}\), \(f_{10}\) \(f_{01}\) 1, odds eq. 16 finite. \(f_{11} = 1\) valid. Rows violate conditions return NA g11, E111 Omega columns, single warning lists affected rows reason. Counts come one set reports (e.g. negative cell) raise error.
